desc:
🏍️ MX RIDE — realistic motocross on Roblox

Real dirt bike physics: throttle, clutch, gears, suspension and body lean all matter. Whip, scrub and send it on motocross tracks, freeride compounds and pump tracks.

⭐ FEATURES
• Realistic bike physics and handling
• Motocross and freeride tracks
• First-person and chase cameras
• Ride with other players in real time
• Bike setups: power, gearing and suspension
• Riders, bikes and your own avatar as a rider
• Replay and photo mode

🎮 CONTROLLER RECOMMENDED
A controller gives the best throttle and lean control. Keyboard and touch also work.

⚠️ EARLY ACCESS
MX Ride is in its early days. Expect bugs, missing features and frequent updates. Your feedback helps shape the game!

This is a fan-made game. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to PiBoSo or MX Bikes.
